//: The type program an EJECTED project compiles under. `tooling/scripts/check-eject.mts` materializes a scaffolded project into a temp directory, runs the real `rebase eject` into it, and drops a tsconfig beside it that `extends` this file — so the options a gate compiles with are a reviewable checked-in file rather than a JSON literal buried inside a script.
//why: `packages/cli/templates/` sits outside the CLI's tsconfig `rootDir`, so nothing in this repository had ever compiled the eject payload. It shipped an entrypoint importing three files that `--headless` deletes and a `serveSPA` path wrong by two directory levels — ordinary type and path errors that any program reading these files would have named. This is that program.
//paths: Relative paths in an extended config resolve against the file that declares them, so these reach this repository's SOURCE from here. Source, not `dist`: the gate runs before `pnpm build` in CI, and a stale `dist` must not be able to make it pass. Third-party specifiers (hono, zod, dotenv, drizzle-orm) are deliberately absent — `hono/cors` is an exports-map subpath, and a `paths` entry would point at a file that does not exist on disk. Those resolve through a `node_modules` symlink the script plants at the pnpm store, which is real resolution, exports maps included.
